observations: The two new items were judged on the exact bytes the review named: the tool_execution_start frames carry `"un\` LF `do"` and `'un\` LF `do'` (hex 5c 0a between `un` and `do` in both). The model kept the line break because the prompt told it each two-line item is one command; a real worker typing a rollback this way would meet the same refusal.

Item 13's result is a run with a jj error (`unrecognized subcommand`, exit 2), not a refusal: the tool marks isError because of the non-zero exit, but the text is jj's own message and a grant was minted for the call. That is precisely the fix's allowed row — bash hands the literal `un\<LF>do` to jj under single quotes — and it left no operation.
Grant minting remains evidence: 7 mints for the 7 bash calls that reached the shell, 0 for the 8 refused, including the new double-quoted form.
The production plugin tree copied into the rig is still pi-legion-envoy 1.23.0 (unchanged since round 2; no guard in its dist).
